A single creature that combines a european rhinoceros beetle and a brown bear. Head of the brown bear, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: brown bear body and legs, with its own dense fur everywhere else, plain coat, no stripes or spots; from the european rhinoceros beetle, as parts and materials on the brown bear's own body: a single curved horn of hard, glossy chitin rising from the brow; a covering of hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams in its own colors that replaces the brown bear's fur over the back and flanks: it grows in the skin as the brown bear's own covering there, not as pieces added on top; the fur stops at the covering's edge, and the belly and legs keep the brown bear's own fur. The covering follows the body outline. Declared fiction: arthropod parts at large size, shown with thick supporting legs and visible breathing openings along the flanks. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.

spark_open.description: The creature is shown in right-facing profile standing on a small patch of ground with stones and sparse grass. It has the overall body shape, dense shaggy fur, and proportions of a large bear, with four thick legs and a short tail, but its dorsal surface from behind the neck to above the hindquarters is covered by a large, glossy, dark reddish-brown segmented exoskeleton, and a single long, curved, ridged horn rises from the center of its forehead. The fur is medium to dark brown with a lighter tan area on the muzzle, lower cheek, and side of the chest. The shell is highly reflective with distinct transverse sutures and a larger shield over the shoulders.

meta_spark.description: A large bulky four-legged mammal shown in side view facing right, covered in long shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan area on the side. It has a bear-like head with a tapered muzzle, small rounded ears, and sturdy legs ending in clawed paws, plus a small stub tail at the rear. A single long slender curved segmented dark reddish-black horn rises from the center of its forehead, and a large glossy dark reddish-brown segmented dome covers its entire back from behind the neck to above the tail.
